children: has reached an agreement with unions at its Loulo-Gounkoto gold complex in Mali, heading off strikes that threatened to disrupt operations beginning Monday.

The agreement covers workers at the mine as well as Food & Events Africa, a contractor providing catering and support services. Unions had raised grievances over overtime pay, expense reimbursements and implementation of existing labor agreements.
For investors, the agreement removes a near-term operational risk at one of Barrick’s

key African gold assets just as Loulo-Gounkoto is recovering from a prolonged shutdown. The mine only recently returned to Barrick’s control following a bitter dispute with Mali’s government, making uninterrupted production important to rebuilding output and cash flow from the complex.
Loulo-Gounkoto, near Mali’s border with Senegal, has faced years of uncertainty after the government introduced a new mining code in 2023 seeking a larger share of mining revenue.
The dispute subsequently escalated, with Malian authorities detaining Barrick
employees, seeking hundreds of millions of dollars in alleged unpaid obligations and seizing roughly three tons of gold. Barrick
suspended operations in January 2025 and pursued international arbitration before Mali placed the complex under provisional state administration.

and the government reached a settlement in November 2025 that returned operational control to the company. The miner later restarted production and said Loulo-Gounkoto produced about 190,000 ounces (7.18 ton) of gold during the first half of 2026.

The latest labor dispute threatened that recovery. Food & Events Africa workers had planned a five-day strike starting Sept. 28, while workers at Barrick's Somilo and Gounkoto units had separately threatened four-day stoppages.
The agreement eliminates those planned walkouts, at least for now, allowing Barrick
to continue ramping up the complex following last year’s political and operational disruptions.

title: Barrick averts strike at Mali gold complex after union deal
